data.long_meaning: In Greek, Dorry means 'gift of God'. This name is derived from the Greek word 'doron', which means 'gift'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl, emphasizing the idea of divine blessings and gifts from the heavens. The name Dorry carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dorry usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
